title: The High-Speed SPI Protocol
summary: Transmit megabits per second to displays and radios with 4-wire SPI (MOSI, MISO, SCK, CS).

steps.title: When Speed Matters
steps.markdownContent: While I2C is great for simple sensors, high-speed graphics displays and 2.4GHz wireless transceivers need blazing data rates. **SPI** (Serial Peripheral Interface) operates at up to 8 MHz!

steps.title: The 4 SPI Lines
steps.markdownContent:
- `MOSI` (Pin 11): Master Out, Slave In (Arduino to device)
- `MISO` (Pin 12): Master In, Slave Out (Device to Arduino)
- `SCK` (Pin 13): Clock rhythm ticks
- `CS / SS` (Pin 10): Chip Select to choose which chip talks!

steps.title: Chip Select (CS) Control
steps.markdownContent: To talk to an SPI chip, pull its CS pin `LOW`. Send your data packets, then set CS back to `HIGH` to end the conversation.

steps.title: SPI Line Checkpoint
steps.markdownContent: Which SPI line carries data FROM the peripheral BACK to the Arduino?
